back: An obstacle that prevents the team from achieving its objectives; also called a blocker.
A current condition that may affect objectives; it has already occurred and may need immediate action.
A risk is uncertain and in the future; an issue is happening now. An issue may arise from a poorly managed risk.
It becomes an issue: log it and carry out the planned response (Implement Risk Responses).
A response to a negative risk that has occurred.
Where issues are recorded and monitored: type, raised by and when, description, priority, assignee, target date, status, final solution.
Do not always become risks; often resolved through collaborative problem-solving as information arrives.
What it blocks, across schedule, budget, scope and stakeholders; how long it has been blocked.
For unexpected delays: visualize blockers, run delay diagnostics, limit WIP, shorten feedback loops.
On visual controls: each impediment, its severity and the actions being taken.
Iteration-based: 'What are my impediments?'. Flow-based: 'Any bottlenecks or blockers to the flow?'
Members raise impediments immediately and swarm on blocked work without fear of blame.
By impact on objectives; the issue log records a priority for each issue.
Finding solutions: gathering information, critical thinking, creative, quantitative or logical approaches.
Finds the basic reason; when all root causes are removed, the problem does not recur.
Expose and communicate bottlenecks so teams resolve them; bridge builders, not decision-makers for others.
Work with departments whose processes slow teams: documentation, finance, CCBs, audits, release queues.
Empower impediment escalation, timebox spikes, swarm on systemic blockers.

front: Project managers in larger agile settings
back: Coordinate across teams, escalate and remove organization-level impediments, guide teams through governance.
When the solution needs authority beyond the team or project manager, along the agreed path.
Daily meetings, issue log updates, retrospective action items, Monitor Risks.
Pick the most important impediments to remove and follow through.
Involve those affected and those who can solve it; approach a conflict directly first; record the solution.

front: Processes that update the issue log
back: Among others, Implement Risk Responses and Monitor Risks.
Removes impediments so the team can work; does not take over the team's work or decisions.
